villager.notes: Raw resource_gatherer_ext values of the French villager entity; gather_rate taken as resource per second, carry in resource units. Speed is the raw moving_ext default_speed in engine units; no tile conversion is applied. Base train time is before the French Town Center bonus (townCenter.villagerProductionMultiplierByAge).

townCenter.notes: Production-speed (rate) multiplier on every French Town Center queue, villagers, scouts and TC research (Textiles); effective villager time = 20 / multiplier. Primary candidate +15/+15/+20/+25% comes from the current civ-summary trait formatter in the standard army record (same formatter carries -50% drop-off and -35% eco-tech args, both confirmed by raw records). Alternative +10/+15/+20/+20% comes from the three always-on TC abilities town_center_production_age1/2/3_fre (attached to both capital and extra TC; age3 record also covers Imperial, no age4 record), matching the older codex copy 11197894 that also states a stale 30% tech discount. Runtime value lives in an undecoded state tree. Extra TC: requires feudal_age (or the rogue-mode fast_expand boon).
